name: The Nightfall
description: Mahir, whose father was assassinated in the city of Denizli by Kürşat Kilimci, returns twenty years later as a police inspector, determined to avenge his father's death. On his first day back, he has a fateful encounter with a mesmerizing girl named Canfeza, the daughter of Kürşat, and instantly falls in love. As Mahir searches for this mysterious woman, he also keeps a close watch on Kürşat, waiting for him to slip up. Mahir realizes his chance will come at the wedding of Kürşat's daughter. But what he doesn't know is that this event will change his life forever, marking the beginning of a night filled with unexpected twists.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After his father is assassinated in Denizli, Mahir returns to the city twenty years later as a police commissioner to take revenge on his father's killer. However, the first day he arrives in the city, he falls in love with a beautiful Yoruk girl whom he meets mystically. He calls this fairy tale-like girl, whose name he cannot learn, Şehrazad. While searching for Şehrazad, Mahir, who is also waiting for his father's murderer, Kürşat Kilimci, to reveal himself, realizes that he will get the opportunity he has been waiting for at Kürşat's daughter's wedding. However, although he does not know it yet, this wedding is where Mahir's life will change forever and a night of fairy tales will begin.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mahir's discovery that Şehrazad is actually Canfeza, the daughter of Kürşat Kilimci, puts him in a difficult situation. He is forced to make a plan. On one side, there is the promise he made to his father and the operation he will perform, and on the other side, there is a fairy-tale princess he fell in love with at first sight. Mahir, who thinks he has created a perfect plan, is put in a dead end by a gamble Canfeza plays with Selim. Mahir will either sacrifice his revenge or Canfeza. He makes his choice.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mahir, who married Canfeza to Selim with his hand, now takes action to keep the promise he made to his father twenty years ago. However, his plans are sabotaged by a secret hand. With the failure of the operation, Mahir is suspended and comes to the brink of losing his job. In that darkest moment when he hits rock bottom, he makes a decision. And this decision crosses paths with Canfeza once again.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mahir and Canfeza's arrival creates a bomb effect in Asaf Bey's Mansion. As Asaf and Afet, who can't tell Mahir the real reason for inviting him to the mansion, try to find out who Canfeza is and send her away, a deepening and increasingly solid bond begins to form between Mahir and Canfeza. They are now, beyond everything, fateful friends. While the feelings of both of them are rising, a mistake made by Canfeza brings her face to face with Selim.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Mahir, who learns the Yılmaz's true purpose, leaves the mansion with his mother and Canfeza. In the house they settle in with the help of their friend Salih, Mahir and Canfeza confront their feelings openly for the first time. The love between them has now been expressed. While they are perhaps having their happiest day, the Yılmaz family is cornered by the Haroğulları. Kürşat's return turns Canfeza's feelings upside down. Süreyya's mistake puts Canfeza and Süreyya in great danger.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Afet and Asaf, who persuade Mahir to return home with the work they do, are actually involved in a bigger plan. However, when Sıla publicly says that she does not want to marry Mahir, everyone's plans are turned upside down. An alliance is formed between the trio when Canfeza asks Mahir to kidnap Sıla and send her away. While Mahir and Canfeza stand side by side despite everyone, Selim's night raid on the mansion forces Afet and Asaf to rush to implement their plans.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When the pressure of Ezra's arrival to the mansion is added to the pressure of Cabir's wedding, grandfather Asaf suffers a brain hemorrhage. However, this illness will be a turning point for Mahir and Canfeza. While Canfeza believes that this love is impossible and that he will never enter the mansion from which he was expelled, Mahir, with the support of his grandfather, takes action to marry Canfeza and promises to remove all the obstacles in front of them to prove to her that they are not impossible.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Learning about his grandmother's plan, Mahir swears an oath to Afet. He will bring Canfeza to that mansion as his wife. Selim, who kidnapped Sıla, has a completely different story this time. Where Mahir finds Canfeza, all worries and obstacles are left behind. Mahir proposes to Canfeza and promises to prove to her that his family accepts this marriage.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: While Mahir and Canfeza are living their happiest day, on the other hand, everyone is struggling to prevent this wedding from happening. Kürşat's visit to the Yılmaz mansion to take his daughter changes all the balances. On the henna night, a surprise awaits Canfeza.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Mahir's encounter with death plunges the entire family into mourning, while also triggering their traumas regarding Mehmet. Mahir's weakening allows Selim to bring Canfeza back to him. However, Kürşat Kilimci is on the eve of a big game. Kürşat, who has sworn to account for his twenty years of sins, will include a surprise name in his big game.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Mahir's sudden trip to Ankara surprises everyone. On one side, Canfeza, who he thinks does not love him but can not give up on. On the other side, the promise he made to his father. Commissioner Mahir, who gets his job back, makes a decision on his return from Ankara. He takes Canfeza from Selim and goes to Denizli, where everything started. Now it is Canfeza's turn to decide. Either all the promises made there will be kept or their paths will separate forever.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Canfeza's arrival at the mansion changes the balance of the mansion. Ferman and Sevde leave the house. Selim is madly obsessed with Mahir, who stopped his heart and gave him a shock. In a mad rage, he plants a bomb in Mahir's car. Canfeza, on the other hand, decides to get a place in the mansion with Süreyya's support. While trying to adapt to the mansion, she also struggles to regain Mahir, whom she loves dearly. However, the big secret she unintentionally learns about the Yilmaz family causes a terrible accident.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Mahir, who is devastated by the fear of losing Canfeza, goes crazy when he learns that Canfeza, who was discharged from the hospital, went to his father's house. He has to persuade Canfeza to come home because no matter how angry he is with her, he is not willing to stay away even for a day. On the other hand, Canfeza, who stipulates Mahir to return home, turns the crisis into an opportunity and makes a request from Afet that is very difficult to accept. Afet's acceptance of this request starts a new power struggle in the mansion. Realizing the bomb planted by Selim, Mahir sets up a big game for Selim.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Selim, who went crazy with the situation Mahir put him in, hit a girl with his car on the way to the mansion, turning Selim's whole world upside down. As the traumas of the past come back, Selim takes this girl, who he does not know, into his home. Sare, who learns about the situation between Mahir and Canfeza, decides to join hands with Salih and reconcile Mahir and Canfeza. The foursome's camping adventure will be full of surprises for both couples. While Mahir is softening towards Canfeza, Canfeza is still upset with Mahir. However, Canfeza, who loves Mahir so much that she will give her life, is torn between her father and Mahir in Selim's loyalty test to Kürşat.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Canfeza's risking her life for Mahir melts the icebergs inside Mahir. However, Canfeza is angry with Mahir. At the same time, she begins to realize that there is something going on between him and her father. Unable to get the answers she was looking for, Canfeza follows Mahir and falls into the middle of an operation, causing an unexpected beauty. Ferman's illegitimate baby Afetgül causes a huge misunderstanding in the mansion. The stored pregnancy test is thought to be Canfeza's. The lady wars escalate in the mansion as the Kilimists come to the mansion to wish them well. The two families, who threw a surprise baby celebration for Canfeza and Mahir, have to find common ground.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: While Canfeza is being pulled over by Mahir for the lie that Mahir has put her in, she is also struggling to exist and establish a business. The name that supports her in this endeavor is one of the most important castles she has lost for Afet. While the uninvited guest who comes to the mansion gets her share of Canfeza's wrath, she also shows all the Yılmazs who the young lady of the mansion is. Mahir will save Canfeza, who gets into trouble for the sake of business. While Mahir resists apologizing, staying away from Canfeza turns into torture for him. However, Canfeza's relationship with Mahir, which is strained due to her suspicions, reaches a point where Canfeza will question Mahir's love.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Mahir is very angry that Canfeza followed her father and witnessed the alliance of Boris, Selim and Kürşat; he is forced to lie to Canfeza because he cannot tell her that he will cooperate with her father. When he finds out that Canfeza has doubts about his love, he is devastated. Mahir, who regrets and decides to save Canfeza from the wrong thoughts and doubts he put her through, decides to turn their marriage into a real marriage on New Year's Eve and apologize. The New Year's Eve party organized by Ferman is pregnant with the explosion of big secrets and the beginning of new loves. While everyone is having a wonderful night leaving all the resentments and misunderstandings from the old year behind, no one will wake up the first morning of the new year the same way.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Mahir saving Kürşat's life by donating blood further fuels Canfeza's anger towards her father. Kürşat is gradually losing his daughter. Meanwhile, Mahir is caught between his mother and Canfeza. While trying to convince Süreyya, he also keeps Canfeza away from the house to prevent her from hearing. However, a tough night awaits Mahir, who cannot stay apart from Canfeza even for one night, at Kürşat's house. Mahir's surprise for Canfeza with the shop and their plans for spending a night together, deepening their bond, are pregnant with shocking secrets and unwanted guests.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The revelation that Afet wrote the letter causes great chaos at home. The fifty-year marriage of Asaf and Afet is on the brink of collapse. Mahir, who is very angry with his grandmother, will now have to help her. Mahir and Canfeza’s room, which has almost turned into a therapy center, never stays empty. While Canfeza plans a surprise honeymoon night for Mahir, Mahir becomes suspicious because of their new neighbor, Boğaç. The relationship between Canfeza and Kürşat is almost at the breaking point. Feeling sorry for Kürşat, Mahir decides to tell Canfeza the truth. While Afet tries to save her marriage by applying the tips she received from Mahir; she gets hold of a New Year’s video that arrives at the house. Afet, who is confronting secrets, is in for a shocking piece of news from Sevde.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Canfeza, who is very angry and hurt by the truth she learned from Mahir, decides to take a break from their relationship and goes to Kürşat's house. While Mahir tries to earn forgiveness, he also has to deal with his family's problems. Efsane has disappeared after learning about Sevde's pregnancy. Ferman falls into a deep heartache and leans on Mahir. Afet, on the other hand, takes Sevde to a fake teacher. This visit plants a seed of doubt in Sevde's mind. While tensions rise between Canfeza and Mahir, Canfeza falls into a trap set by İnci, leaving Mahir in turmoil.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Canfeza's arrest and appearance on television cause great tension at home. While Mahir defends and protects Canfeza against everyone, he also tries to deal with the problems Canfeza causes him. Trying to keep Canfeza under control and prevent their relationship from being damaged, Mahir decides to spend more time with Canfeza. The circle is gradually closing in on Ferman. His move brings Ferman face to face with his father. Realizing that she has put Mahir in a difficult position with his superiors and family, Canfeza promises to behave and not to hide anything from Mahir anymore. However, will the trap Selim Allame has drawn Canfeza into allow this?

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Mahir, who is worried about the surprise Canfeza is planning for his birthday, suggests that they make a plan together for both his birthday and Valentine's Day. Meanwhile, Raşit, who is determined to find Lord, sets up a terrifying life-or-death game with Savaş's help. In this game, either Raşit or Lord will die. Unaware of the trap set for them, Mahir and Canfeza head to a cabin in the mountains for a night alone, where they share deep memories and gifts about each other and their pasts. That night, which brings their bodies and souls together, is on the brink of a dark morning.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: While Mahir is searching for ways to escape from the grave in which he is buried alive, a helping hand reaches out to him from an unexpected place. Mahir keeps his promise to his father and after the evidence he presents, he is promoted to Chief Superintendent instead of Raşit, which makes the whole family experience both great pride and very emotional moments. Deciding to make a gesture to Mahir on these happy days, Asaf prepares a holiday for the family to go on. However, the end of this holiday will be the beginning of great events and chaos for both the Yılmaz family and Gülizar and Kürşat.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: The union of Gülizar and Kürşat creates a bomb effect in the Yılmaz mansion. Before the repercussions of this event can be overcome, a truth that Mahir learns about his grandmother drives him crazy. Mahir makes a decision. Mahir, who has located Selim Allame, who has been wanted since Raşit's death, carries out a major operation. However, the move that Selim makes when he is about to be caught shocks even Mahir. While Mahir and Canfeza, who moved to their new home on the first day of Ramadan, are living the happiest days of their lives, an insidious disaster is approaching them.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Mahir being shot in the back like his father deeply shakes the whole family. Canfeza's fear of losing Mahir, which she experiences for the second time, increases her concerns. There is one issue that needs to be resolved. That is Selim. Kürşat and Gülizar are determined to get married, but an unexpected move prevents their marriage. Ferman makes a big decision. He tells Sevde that he wants a divorce. While everyone is busy with their own lives, Süreyya decides to keep the promise she made to her husband in the hospital and disappears.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Kürşat’s long-lost son, Ozan, arrives like a storm, shaking up the lives of not only Kürşat but also Canfeza and Mahir. However, Ozan is hiding many secrets from the Kilimci family. When Kürşat storms the Kilimci mansion to take Gülizar and has Afet arrested, tensions between Mahir and Canfeza reach a breaking point. Despite their relentless clashes under the same roof, love continues to prevail in their battle. Meanwhile, the arrival of Ferman’s mother at the mansion leads to an unexpected encounter with Sevde, pushing both Afet and Sevde down an irreversible path. At the same time, Sare finally meets her mother, Handan, whom she has never seen before. But Handan has a shocking surprise in store for the entire Kilimci family.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After the shocking events, everyone struggles with their own problems, and tensions rise once again between Mahir and Canfeza. While Canfeza gets lost in the troubles her father has brought into her life and is constantly manipulated by her brother, she fails to notice what Mahir is going through. Despite this, Mahir tries to mend their relationship while also uncovering a shocking secret about his father. However, this revelation opens a new door in his father’s murder case. Meanwhile, Ferman, who has become best friends with Süreyya, jumps from one adventure to another but is devastated by heartbreaking news. As for Afet, she is forced to take in Fatma, who has become a major problem for her.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: After Mahir leaves home, Canfeza feels both anxious and angry. Her father’s words frighten her, and while she does everything she can to bring Mahir back, she is unaware that Mahir never actually left. Sevde’s death causes deep sorrow in the family, and now, with no obstacles left for Ferman to get married, he finds himself facing opposition from his family. As Mahir and Canfeza try to repair their relationship, a conversation between Süreyya and Kürşat opens a door for Ozan. With the lies he tells Canfeza, he manages to convince her to attend the launch event. When Mahir uncovers Ozan’s connection to Raşit and hears that Canfeza went to the launch, he completely loses it.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Canfeza discovering her brother’s connection to Raşit leads to a new alliance with Mahir. As the two work through the problems they’ve been facing for weeks—much like Urfalı and Şehrazad—they also rekindle their love. They’re not the only ones mending what’s been broken. Sare notices something unusual about her mother and brother and tries to make amends for her own mistakes, while also offering Mahir and Canfeza an unexpected clue. Mahir and Canfeza’s cooperation begins to unravel Ozan’s plans. Unaware of their alliance, a panicked Ozan makes a misstep and brings Gökçe home. In a bold move to find the girl, Mahir and Canfeza secretly break into Ozan’s house, risking everything.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: While Canfeza and Mahir investigate Ozan’s secrets, they also savor the sweetness of their own love. A clue they discover about Gökçe leads them into an unexpected adventure. At the mansion, Afet and Süreyya devise a plan based on an idea from Canfeza: to marry Fatma off to a wealthy and elderly family friend in order to get her out of their lives. But an unexpected twist throws everything into chaos. While rehearsing their future life together in a countryside home, Mahir and Canfeza return with a major lesson learned—and a life-changing decision. Awaiting Canfeza is a big surprise. When she once asked Mahir, “Can you bring me the stars from the sky?”—her answer will come on a magical evening.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Ferman’s entanglement with the gambling mafia prompts Mahir to take action, while Asaf is once again forced to confront secrets from the past. Asaf offers Mahir control over his entire fortune and business—on the condition that Mahir leaves the police force. However, Mahir is already under the scrutiny of his superiors. He attends a dinner with police chiefs alongside Canfeza, where promising news awaits regarding his career. A dream she has during a fainting spell deeply affects Canfeza, filling her with anxiety about the days ahead—and not without reason. As a subtle danger looms around them, a mysterious package arrives at their home, addressed to Canfeza. Reflecting on recent events, Mahir realizes he has placed Canfeza in the middle between his own family and hers far too often. He decides to organize a birthday celebration that brings both families together—for her.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: After finding Canfeza and learning that Selim is alive, Mahir decides they should stay at the mansion for security reasons. Meanwhile, tensions have reached a breaking point. Mahir presents Kürşat with a difficult choice. Mahir, who chooses not to tell Canfeza that Selim Allame is alive, begins preparations for a major operation with Kürşat’s help. To lift Canfeza’s spirits, he takes her out for the evening, and the two return home at the end of the night. However, the next day, Asaf learns that Mahir has walked into a major trap during the operation targeting Ozan.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: As Canfeza struggles under the weight of a painful truth she’s learned about Asaf, her world is turned upside down by unexpected news—she’s pregnant. Meanwhile, Afet, having shed her own burdens and rid herself of Fatma, begins tormenting the new brides in the house once again. But Mahir delivers the ultimate shock by gifting the mansion to Canfeza, silencing Afet's attempts to belittle her. Fed up with everything, Ferman decides to secretly marry Efsane and hosts a bachelor party at Mahir’s house. However, things spiral out of control when Ferman invites dancers, and the party is crashed by Canfeza and the others—leading to chaos. Amid the confusion, Canfeza, still glowing with excitement over her pregnancy, comes face to face with a dangerous secret—one that puts her life on the line.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Afet listening to her conscience at the last moment and saving Canfeza brings relief to everyone. Wanting to make things right, Mahir decides to renew their vows — this time, with everything exactly as it should be. At the ceremony, both families receive joyful news: a baby is on the way. But just as the celebration begins, chaos erupts when a video surfaces revealing that Afet was responsible for Sevde’s death. Meanwhile, in a desperate move to save Mahir, Kürşat shoots his own son — but he’s unable to stop Mahir from unexpectedly learning Asaf’s biggest secret. What Mahir now knows pushes Canfeza and their baby to the edge of a cliff, forcing him to make an impossible decision.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: After learning the truth about his grandfather, Mahir has all the associated men arrested and is summoned to Ankara. Meanwhile, there's a bittersweet rush at home in preparation for the holiday. Despite everything they’ve been through, Canfeza and Mahir are filled with new hope when Mahir dreams of his father giving him the joyful news about their baby’s gender. As they cling to each other and their child, Eid al-Adha brings the Yılmaz and Kilimci families together at the same table. But Ozan, shaken by his father's betrayal, has no intention of slowing down. He sets a terrifying trap — forcing Mahir to choose between Canfeza’s life or killing Kürşat.
